basis: Platelet dysfunction/asplenia and myopathy define syndrome; ichthyosis 80-99%; dyslexia is defining and stroke-like episodes reported in 3/3; miosis alone does not show visual damage.
Severe developmental delay 8/8; cardiac defects 6/8, sensorineural deafness 5/5 and skeletal defects 6/6. Cleft palate 3/6 and nail hypoplasia 6/6 omitted by cap.
Defined by malformations and neoplastic growths of skin and nervous system; additional organ disease varies across subtypes.
Immune dysregulation directly causes dermatitis 15/16, asthma 11/16 and gastrointestinal eosinophilic infiltration 10/16; eosinophilia alone does not establish blood-organ damage.
Neoplasm originates in the hilar region of the lung.
Severe skeletal dysplasia; thoracic restriction with respiratory insufficiency, cleft palate and hearing abnormalities each 30-79%; nail hypoplasia omitted by cap.
Beckwith-Wiedemann phenotype includes defining macroglossia and abdominal-wall defects; transient hypoglycemia, organ enlargement and tumor risk alone do not establish lasting organ damage.
Localized anterior staphyloma is an ectatic structural disorder of the eye.
DCX-related cortical malformation causes seizures and cognitive impairment; contractures reflect neurologic motor dysfunction, without established direct musculoskeletal disease.
Carcinoma originates in cutaneous sweat glands and occupies dermis or subcutaneous tissue.
Renal epithelial carcinoma originating from collecting-duct intercalated cells.
Oligodendroglial tumor of the central nervous system occurring in adulthood.
Syndrome defined by enchondromatosis, skeletal short stature and deafness; no evidence supports additional organ involvement.
Disorder of auditory function characterized by abnormally reduced sound tolerance.
The defining triad comprises gastrointestinal stromal tumors, pulmonary chondromas and extraadrenal neuroendocrine paragangliomas.
Outer retinal dysfunction causes visual-field loss; proposed infectious or autoimmune causes remain unestablished.
Autonomous parathyroid hormone excess; chronic skeletal resorption and bone loss commonly exceed 30%. Renal disease is usually the antecedent cause, not damage attributable to this condition.
Primary neurologic headache syndrome; cranial autonomic symptoms do not establish lasting ocular, airway or vascular damage.
Approximately 80-90% arise in pleura; peritoneal and pericardial tumors are minority anatomical subtypes, not common additional organ involvement.
Defective cortisol regeneration causes ACTH-driven adrenal androgen excess; acanthosis and advanced bone age alone do not establish lasting skin or skeletal damage.
Dermatan-sulfate storage causes skeletal disease/contractures ~100%, corneal opacity 28/28 and mitral regurgitation 27/28; airway, ear, skin and oral disease omitted by cap.
Inherited dental enamel disorder; enamel hypoplasia affects 11/11 patients. Teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Infantile lysosomal neurodegeneration; skeletal disease and blindness each 80-99%. Hearing loss and cardiomyopathy omitted by cap; organomegaly alone does not establish dysfunction.
Umbrella of ATP1A3-related neurologic disorders; optic atrophy and hearing loss characterize particular subtypes rather than most patients across the group.
Predominantly ovarian mature cystic teratomas, with reproductive origin outside the axes; extragonadal sites are minority variants. Internal skin or teeth do not determine tumor origin.
